title: Python: the #6 descendant loop in the attribute-write guard over-refuses exact-class paths and shares the (2b) mixin gap (DEC-303 (a94) item 5)
description: Ordinary follow-up filed under DEC-303 (a94) item 5 (opum-ai/opum-doc#2112, ODOC-640). The GCLI-156 #6 descendant loop in src/python/calls.ts consults descendants without the exact-class narrowing GCLI-151 round 2 applied: it can over-refuse paths that can only hold a fresh exact class, and it shares (2b)'s gap where a __class__ write recorded on a descendant's MIXIN is invisible because the loop reads each descendant's own write set rather than its MRO. Not a hold item; scope it before building and keep any change removal-only. Dev evidence is recorded on GCLI-151 round 2.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The #6 loop is measured on dev with an exact-class shape and with a mixin write, each with a resolving twin, and the over-refusal and the miss are both stated
Any analyzer change is removal-only, with a fixture and a mutant observed red per path, and removal-only proved by the subset check with flags

plan: 1. Scope measured read-only on dev dd1781ce: the exact-class over-refusal (three sites) and the mixin miss, each with a resolving twin.
2. Build the MIXIN half only (DEC-303 (a98) item 2): the #6 loop walks each descendant MRO and fails closed on an uncomputable one; the loop still runs for every receiver, as on dev.
3. Carry the calls.ts doc-comment correction in the same change.

4. Fixtures and mutants: the mixin write refuses with a no-write resolving twin and an own-write twin; the C3-conflict fail-closed pin; the proven refusals that hold on the mixin-only analyzer stay pinned. Mutant M6 (own-write read) and M8 (drop fail-closed) red; five-pin kit 0 created / 0 removed / 0 flag-changed against dev at the branch point.
5. Two rounds, one PR on a task branch off dev, CI by ref, report PR number + head SHA and every fixture-created/removed edge. The narrowing half moves to GCLI-172 as a named item.
implementationNotes: Carry on this task's PR or the next src change (reviewer nit on opum-ai/glyph-cli#264, non-blocking, not fixed there): the calls.ts:3504-3505 doc comment in duplicateImportedClass says an import followed by a non-import rebinding is 'answered as rebound, never multiply'. That is false for a class or def rebinding: such a binding is not dynamic, so resolveBareName reaches multiply and the helper refuses it per binding at 3515. The test comment at test/python-calls.test.ts:597-599 states the right thing. Correct the comment when next touching the file; no behaviour change, no fixture change.
